correctness.rationale: For a finite minimum-product A, sum U <= product U and q>16M^4 force the product R of all but the largest competitor prime below M; R>M contradicts q(R-M)<=R(u-d) and R<4M², R=M yields the same A via unique factorization. Then t=q+d-u gives exactly the finite even-shift condition, with strict comparison in converse. Selberg sieve yields O_A(X/log² X) exclusions. Independently re-enumerated Δ_{3,5}={6,8} ; inspected the source’s large-prime witness without an independent primality run; finite checks are not the proof.
